question: At 120 Splinters of Wrath, does the Syndra rotation's sphere-consumption list have a second entry, and is that entry 'Q2'?

step_1_stack_count_unlocks_every_transce.source: data/champions.json Syndra.P / Q / W / E / R 'Transcendent Bonus' effects
quotes: P: 'Syndra collects Splinters of Wrath that enhance each of her abilities based on the number of them collected, stacking up to 120 times.'
P: 'At 120 Splinters of Wrath, Syndra achieves Transcendence, increasing her ability power by 15%.'
Q: 'Transcendent Bonus: Collecting 40 Splinters of Wrath causes Syndra to periodically stock a Dark Sphere charge, up to a maximum of 2.'
W: 'Transcendent Bonus: Collecting 60 Splinters of Wrath ...'

step_1_stack_count_unlocks_every_transce.arithmetic: scenario stack count S = 120; thresholds T = {40 (Q), 60 (W), 80 (E), 100 (R), 120 (P)}; S >= max(T) = 120, so ALL five bonuses are active. In particular S = 120 >= 40, so the Q charge-stock bonus is active.
step_1_stack_count_unlocks_every_transce.conclusion: Dark Sphere charge capacity at S=120 is 2 (max stated by the wiki), not 1.

quotes: Q notes: 'There is no limit as to how many Dark Spheres can be active at a time.'
Q notes: 'After Syndra gains the Transcendent bonus, the number of Dark Sphere charges available is represented by small Sphere icons under her health bar.'
Q: 'Syndra conjures a Dark Sphere at the target location that appears after a 0.6-second delay ... The Dark Sphere then remains on the ground for 6 seconds.'
step_2_two_charges_means_two_spheres_exi.arithmetic: Base Q recharge is 7 s and is NOT reduced by CDR, so with 1 charge only one Q sphere could exist per 7 s window; a second sphere inside a single rotation is possible ONLY via the 40-splinter charge stock. With capacity 2 and a full stock at fight start, casts Q1 and Q2 are both available at t=0 with no cooldown wait. Cast times: Q 'none', W 'none', E 0.25 s, R 0.25 s; using the engine's documented 0.5 s inter-cast GCD estimate for one-rotation spread (math-foundations, burn row), a Q-Q-W(-recast)-E-R rotation spans ~2.0-3.0 s < the 6 s sphere ground duration (and W's grab refreshes that duration). Both spheres are therefore live for the whole rotation. Charge cap = 2 also bounds it from above: no 'Q3' exists.
step_2_two_charges_means_two_spheres_exi.conclusion: Exactly two Dark Spheres, from Q cast 1 and Q cast 2, exist and are available to be consumed. |consume| = 2, so index 1 must be populated (old value <absent> is under-length).

quotes: W: 'Syndra telekinetically grabs the nearest Dark Sphere, enemy minion or non-epic monster ... She prioritizes grabbing the nearest unit, then Dark Spheres.' / notes: 'Grabbing prioritizes Dark Spheres.' -> W removes and throws one sphere.
R: 'Syndra conjures 3 Dark Spheres and additionally grabs up to 4 nearby live ones.' -> R consumes up to 4 live ground spheres; 2 <= 4.
R notes: 'Unleashed Power will not add a Sphere that Syndra is holding with Force of Will.'

E: 'Dark Spheres can be knocked back for 950 units ...' / notes: 'Scatter the Weak will delay the expiration of a Sphere until after it finishes being knocked back.' -> E displaces a sphere, it does not consume it.
step_3_both_spheres_are_actually_consume.arithmetic: Consumers in the rotation: W throw (1 sphere) + R grab (up to 4 live spheres). If W is holding one sphere at R time, R skips that one (R note) but W's throw still consumes it. Either partition -- {W: Q1, R: Q2} or {W: Q2, R: Q1} or {R: Q1, Q2} -- consumes 2 spheres total. E consumes 0.
step_3_both_spheres_are_actually_consume.conclusion: Total consumed spheres = 2 under every legal partition.

step_4_ordering_convention_puts_Q2_at_in.source: docs/math-foundations.md (engine consumption-order convention) + Syndra Q sphere lifetime
quotes: math-foundations, Shield absorption row: 'Consumption order = earliest-expiring timed shields first, then untimed pools (FIFO proxy)'
math-foundations, Ability rotation casts row: 'shared-timeline renewal schedule; cast starts within window ... R single-cast'
Q: 'The Dark Sphere then remains on the ground for 6 seconds.'
step_4_ordering_convention_puts_Q2_at_in.arithmetic: Every sphere carries the same 6 s timer started at its own creation, so earliest-expiring == oldest == creation order: Q1 (cast at t0) expires at t0+6, Q2 (cast at t0+dt, dt>0) expires at t0+6+dt. The engine's documented consumption convention is earliest-expiring-first / FIFO, and W's real tiebreak ('nearest') is spatial and not derivable in a positionless model, so creation order is the only derivable total order. FIFO => consume = [Q1, Q2] => consume[0] = 'Q1', consume[1] = 'Q2'. A LIFO convention (which would put 'Q1' at index 1) has no support anywhere in the wiki text: W grabs the NEAREST sphere, R grabs ALL nearby live ones, and neither is newest-first.

independent_computation.result: consume = ['Q1', 'Q2']; consume[1] = 'Q2', matching the new value. The old state (leaf absent, i.e. a 1-element consume list) is inconsistent with the 40-splinter Dark Sphere charge stock being active at S=120.

caveats: The scenario definition itself is not present under data/, so the rotation's exact cast list could not be read; the derivation therefore establishes (a) that two Dark Spheres necessarily exist and are consumed at S=120, and (b) that the engine's documented FIFO/earliest-expiring consumption convention orders them Q1 then Q2. Both are needed for consume[1]='Q2'.

W's real in-game tiebreak is 'nearest', which is spatial and not representable in a positionless damage model; FIFO by creation is the only order derivable from the cached sources, and it agrees with math-foundations' stated consumption convention.
The charge cap of 2 also bounds the list from above: a third entry ('Q3') would be wrong.
